questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is FALSE?
options: Hydropower produces less electricity than wind in the United States
Transmission systems operate at high voltages to minimize energy loss
The Pearl Street Station initially used alternating current (AC)
Smart meters cover approximately 75% of U.S. households
Utilities invest about $63 billion annually in grid infrastructure
questions.explanation: The text states that the Pearl Street Station initially used a direct current (DC) system, making statement C false.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
options: Coal is the primary source of electricity generation in the United States
Thomas Edison's Pearl Street Station opened in 1882
Modern transmission lines typically operate at 50,000 volts maximum
Renewable energy sources are completely stable and predictable
Smart grid technology has been widely rejected by utilities
questions.explanation: The text mentions that Thomas Edison's Pearl Street Station opened in 1882.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is FALSE?
options: Russia launched its full-scale invasion in February 2021
The invasion included attacks from multiple fronts including Belarus
Russia had previously annexed Crimea in 2014
The United States has provided HIMARS rocket systems to Ukraine
The conflict created Europe's largest refugee crisis since World War II
questions.explanation: The text states the invasion occurred on February 24, 2022, not 2021.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
options: International sanctions have had no effect on Russia's economy
European countries reduced their gas consumption by 18% during a specific period
The conflict has displaced fewer than 1 million people from Ukraine
Military aid to Ukraine has been limited to non-lethal equipment
The fighting in eastern Ukraine began in 2020
questions.explanation: The text notes that member states reduced gas consumption by 18% between August 2022 and March 2023.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is FALSE?
options: Real Madrid was founded in 1902
The club has won 20 UEFA Champions League titles
Francisco Gento won six European Cups
El Clásico refers to the rivalry between Real Madrid and FC Barcelona
Real Madrid is structured as a member-owned club
questions.explanation: The text mentions a record 14 UEFA Champions League titles, not 20.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
options: Real Madrid received its "Real" designation in 1950
AC Milan has won more European Cups than Real Madrid
The Santiago Bernabéu Stadium has a capacity of 81,044
Real Madrid is owned by a single wealthy individual
Florentino Pérez has never returned to the presidency after his first term
questions.explanation: The text states that the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium currently seats 81,044 spectators.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is FALSE?
options: The NBA was founded as the Basketball Association of America
The three-point line was implemented in the 1960s
Analytics have caused a decline in mid-range jump shots
International players represent about 25% of NBA rosters
The current NBA media rights deal is worth $24 billion
questions.explanation: The three-point line was implemented in the 1979-1980 season, not the 1960s.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
options: NBA teams averaged more three-point attempts in the league's early years
The league has never employed female referees
The average NBA salary is approximately $9.5 million
The NBA's international expansion has been unsuccessful
Television rights represent a minor revenue source for the NBA
questions.explanation: The text states the average annual salary rose to approximately $9.5 million for the 2022-2023 season.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is FALSE?
options: The Achilles tendon connects the calf muscles to the heel bone
The Achilles can withstand forces up to 12.5 times body weight during running
Most athletes return to 100% of pre-injury performance after Achilles ruptures
Recovery from surgical repair typically takes 6-9 months
Fluoroquinolone antibiotics are a risk factor for Achilles injuries
questions.explanation: The text notes a performance decline and that approximately 30% never return to pre-injury performance levels.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
options: Achilles injuries are most common in teenagers
Non-operative treatment has a higher re-rupture rate than surgical intervention
Achilles tendinopathy responds poorly to eccentric strengthening
The Achilles is the weakest tendon in the human body
Corticosteroid injections help prevent Achilles injuries
questions.explanation: The text indicates lower re-rupture rates with surgical intervention (3.5%) compared to non-operative treatment (12.6%).

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is FALSE?
options: Antibiotic development has accelerated rapidly since 1980
Teixobactin was discovered using the iChip platform
The World Health Organization describes antimicrobial resistance as a "slow-motion pandemic"
Artificial intelligence has helped identify new antibacterial compounds
The UK has piloted a subscription model for antibiotic access
questions.correctAnswer: Antibiotic development has accelerated rapidly since 1980
questions.explanation: The text states that antibiotic development has slowed dramatically since the "golden age" of discovery between 1940 and 1960, with only nine new classes approved since 1980.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
options: Economic incentives for antibiotic development are very strong
Teixobactin targets bacterial cell wall synthesis
Most soil bacteria are easily cultured in laboratory settings
Antibiotic stewardship has no effect on pharmaceutical company revenues
Halicin was discovered through traditional screening methods
questions.correctAnswer: Teixobactin targets bacterial cell wall synthesis
questions.explanation: The text explicitly states that Teixobactin represents the first member of a potentially new class targeting cell wall synthesis.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is FALSE?
options: CBCT imaging produces 3D images of oral structures
Digital dentistry requires higher radiation doses than conventional methods
CAD/CAM systems can produce same-day dental restorations
Air abrasion technology can remove decay without traditional drilling
Silver diamine fluoride can arrest caries progression
questions.correctAnswer: Digital dentistry requires higher radiation doses than conventional methods
questions.explanation: The text states that CBCT provides detailed 3D imaging with radiation doses 10-100 times lower than conventional CT scans, not higher.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
options: Laser dentistry typically increases bleeding during procedures
AI algorithms show lower diagnostic accuracy than human dentists
CAD/CAM systems eliminate the need for traditional impression materials
Bioactive materials prevent ion release in dental restorations
CBCT imaging produces only 2D radiographs
questions.correctAnswer: CAD/CAM systems eliminate the need for traditional impression materials
questions.explanation: The text mentions that CAD/CAM systems enable same-day fabrication... eliminating traditional impression materials.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
options: One Direction released a total of three studio albums
"What Makes You Beautiful" reached number one in the UK
The group continues to tour occasionally since their hiatus
None of the members have achieved success as solo artists
One Direction's music receives minimal streaming today
questions.correctAnswer: "What Makes You Beautiful" reached number one in the UK
questions.explanation: The text states that their debut single "What Makes You Beautiful" reached number one in the UK.
